claim: Point sample support, laboratory composite support, covariate support and raster cell support are different; prediction resolution should be interpreted as the support of the modeled product, not the precision of a soil measurement.
conditions: The project treats each laboratory result as one average 0-30 cm sample value and predicts on a raster grid.
limitations: Within-cell and within-composite variation is not resolved by the model and can be substantial.
recommended_action: State depth convention, composite protocol, grid size, native covariate resolutions and intended map scale in the report.
not_allowed_action: Do not interpret sub-pixel variation or extra decimal precision as observed soil detail.
